notes.title: Update Notes BETA 0.2.8 & DEMO 0.2.7
notes.content:
Before presenting the update notes, Ninetales informs that the updates are having problems running on Steam. And so they will not be applied until the problem is resolved. This problem has arisen from the last update of the Steam client and also from the SDK offered so that the game can be published on the platform.

These updates were to be implemented on 11/18/2017 and will be implemented as soon as the problem is fixed.
We're sorry for the inconvenience.

Update Notes Beta 0.2.8 (Forecast to be applied on 12/22/2017)

~ Applying Demo Updates
-Quest from the Harvest of Apples made available in Alpha 0.1.2 reintroduced in BETA
-New NPCs
-***New Achievement - Harvesting apples for a sweet lady
-New Map (Removed)
-New Hunting Quest (Removed)

-------------------------------
Update Notes Demo 0.2.7 (Available now)

-New Move Instructions Screen
-New Interaction Instructions Screen
-New Attack Screen Attacks
-New HUD Instruction Screen with Survival Guide
-New Statistics Screen
-New interaction indicator balloon
-New Indicator of interactions
